messages.text: I’ll use the sensitive detector crossings from the same old and new scans to plot hits versus η, with both stacked and individual-marker versions. I’ll check the hit definition against the recorded steps first.

I’ll define a hit as one distinct sensitive sensor crossed by a ray, so multiple Geant4 steps in one sensor count once. Each plot option will show old and new baselines side by side in the same colors. The environment preflight still reports stale setup records; I’ll verify the loaded runtime before processing.

The material files don’t store sensor identities, and rounded positions can be ambiguous at active/guard boundaries. I’ll count crossings directly from Geant4’s physical-volume paths in matched old/new runs. That gives each sensor a clear identity and avoids treating tiny or repeated material steps as extra hits.

The 300-ray control passed: adding the hit counter leaves all 32 material-recording branches exactly unchanged. It also verified all 46,682 sensitive placements in the new geometry. I’m now running 100,000 matched rays through each baseline.

The independent check agrees with Geant4 for 128 rays when it uses the sensors’ full thickness. A zero-thickness plane check misses a few edge-grazing crossings, so I’ll label the plots as sensitive-volume crossings rather than ACTS plane hits.

Both runs completed successfully, with identical generated rays. The mean count is 14.07 crossings per ray for the old baseline and 14.93 for the new one. Independent finite-sensor checks agree with Geant4 for 256 rays from each baseline. I’m rendering both plot options now.

Both plot options are rendered and checked visually. Pixels account for most of the increase; long-strip counts match exactly for every paired ray. I’m packaging the plots, binwise data and reproduction recipe, then getting a separate review of the results.

All 5 new checks pass, and the 17 existing material-comparison checks still pass. PNG, PDF and SVG exports are ready for both formats; the original material files are unchanged. I’m finishing the validation record.

Done—old baseline on the left, new on the right. Hits are distinct sensitive-volume crossings per ray, using 100,000 matched rays per baseline.
